# SCHONDELL

SCHONDELL implements AI agents for companies and builds practical AI solutions that make processes visible and automate the work that matters.

## Primary Website

- https://schondell.com/
- Swedish: https://schondell.com/index-sv.html
- German: https://schondell.com/index-de.html
- French: https://schondell.com/index-fr.html
- .NET modernization: https://schondell.com/dotnet-modernization.html

## What SCHONDELL Does

- Implements AI agents for companies: email triage, quote drafting, document processing, case summarisation, internal knowledge search, and decision support — connected to existing tools via APIs and MCP, with human approval where it matters.
- Visualises business processes so bottlenecks, handovers, manual work, and data gaps become clear.
- Builds focused AI-enabled tools for quoting, scheduling, case handling, document workflows, reporting, knowledge search, and decision support.
- Creates lean alternatives to oversized generic CRM or business systems.
- Integrates existing tools, APIs, files, databases, and cloud services.
- Provides senior software architecture and full-stack delivery.
- Modernizes business-critical .NET Framework 4.x applications to .NET 10 through characterization tests, meaningful test coverage, TDD throughout the conversion, supervised AI assistance, and senior engineering review.
